Counsel for Applicant :- Vimal Shukla Counsel for Opposite Party :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
None has appeared for respondent no.2 despite notice.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.0160 of 2024, under Section 363, 366, 376 IPC, Section 3/4 of POCSO Act & Section 3(2)V & 3(2)Va of SC/ST Act, P.S. Pachperwa, District Balrampur.
3. The FIR in question was lodged alleging that daughter of the informant was missing and was enticed by the applicant.
Subsequently, in the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that she had gone alongwith the applicant out of her own freewill and wanted to marry the applicant.
In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., there was slight variance, however, she stated that she had gone out of her own freewill and nothing wrong was done to her.

4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
5. Considering the two statements, the applicant who is in custody since 02.07.2024 and has no criminal history, is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.
